76. Tamil Nadu has been emerging as the most

preferred destination for manufacturing, trade and

important steps for improving the ease of doing business

note that, the Japan International Co-operation Agency

(JICA) has also agreed to fund the second phase of the

‘Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Programme’ (TNIPP)

with an outlay of Rs.1,560 crores to improve the

investment environment.

investments of Rs.2.42 lakh crores with an employment

totalling Rs.23,258 crores have materialised and have

generated employment for 48,145 persons. As already

announced, this Government is committed to conducting
